title: The Quiet Corner Offered, Not Assigned
youtube_title: The Quiet Corner Offered, Not Assigned | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Kavi is just outside the fun, close to a quiet corner offered as a choice. Sora changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Kavi has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
